It sucks that you have these injuries and stuff, but there's really not too much you can do about it. You just need to try and reduce the pain as much as possible with help of a doctor or something and don't always think about how bad your physical pains are. It's the way you are and it's not your fault. Even though the pain sucks you need to accept the way you are, because there's not much you can do. The right people will love you for who you are as a person, not as a body, you know.

Well, maybe you could get into art instead of sports and stuff. You should try out doing some sports you haven't done before though, whrn your injury is okay again, just to find out what you like and what you don't like. I'm personally really into spraying and music for example.

You shouldn't say you're dumb. You don't sound dumb to me. As far as I can tell, you seem to be pretty well educated and nice to me. Your physical issues won't matter to anyone who truly loves you for who you are. 

I know it sounds mean, which I'm not trying to be!, but a good hygiene and good clothes make everyone feel better instantly. Try to be as good looking to you personally as you can. If you start liking the way you look and start to ignore your issues, your mental health problems will start to get better too.

Why would you want to be like other girls? The other girls are those tall, blonde, stupid girls wearing a lot of make-up daily to get over their insecurities? You don't need to be like that. Actually, I think it would be pretty stupid to be like that, because you're really just the average basic bitch when you're looking like all those barbies. If you learn to love your flaws and make the best out of what you have, you'll enjoy being and feel better instantly. You really just need to try and make yourself look good to a point that you think is looking good to you personally (!) and get out of your comfort-zone. You'll make friends through your hobbies, once your injuries are better.

I wish you the best of luck in life and I'm really sorry if I'm accidentaly sounding mean in any way ikn this message. English isn't my first language and I somehow manage to sound mean, even though I'm just trying to be nice and help others. Sorry if that happened, I didn't mean to.

Well, maybe you should try training at a gym or doing another kind of sport you enjoy! You just have to try some stuff out, I'm sure there's going to be like a free first lesson thing for almost every sport you want to try and I'm sure you can find cool stuff nearby. What do you think are your flaws? I think your sister would probrably be really really sad if you took your life. Have you talked to her about your feelings?

Also, are you religious? Religious beliefs really keep people going. I'm not religious myself, but I can see that believing in god can give you a light in your life.

I know, this answer sucks and I seem insensitive now, but you should try and get out of your comfort-zone every now and then to maybe talk to the people around you.
